other_conditions: Applicant must be a family member or dependent of the deceased person
Deceased person must have been the primary breadwinner of the family
Deceased person must have been between 18 and 60 years old at the time of death
Family must be living below the poverty line (BPL)
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance of ₹20,000 to bereaved families living below the poverty line.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all necessary documents
